_comment: Import resolution for the design-sync converter. FlowViz's package.json sets type=module, so esbuild applies Node ESM-importing-CommonJS interop: a default import of a CommonJS @mui/icons-material/<Icon> yields the module object rather than the component, and every deep-imported icon then renders as 'Element type is invalid ... got: object'. Vite never hits this because it pre-bundles with bundler-style interop. Around 50 distinct deep icon imports exist under src/, so this maps the package's own ESM build instead of patching call sites. Note: the converter strips double-slash sequences as line comments before parsing this file, so neither a comment key nor a comment body may contain one.
